component.name: Alien Thunder
component.summary: Keyboard lighting, G-Mode and temperatures for Alienware laptops
Iluminação do teclado, G-Mode e temperaturas para notebooks Alienware

description.p: Alien Thunder brings the Alienware Command Center features Linux lacks: per-key keyboard lighting, the touchpad, alien head and power button lights, G-Mode on Fn+F1, and live temperature, fan, CPU load and memory readouts.

ul.li: Color every key, save profiles, and import your presets from Windows
Effects for the keyboard, touchpad and alien head that never change your colors
G-Mode on Fn+F1: fans at full speed and the performance power profile
CPU and GPU temperature, fan speeds, CPU load, VRAM and RAM on the KDE Plasma panel and in an overlay above games

description.p: Tested on the Alienware m16 R2. The panel widget and the overlay need KDE Plasma 6; the lighting editor and G-Mode work on other desktops too.

screenshot.caption: Readouts that float above every window

ul.li: Add configurable desktop and panel gauges with smoothed network overlays
packages/: on Arch, install the downloaded file, since pacman wants a trusted signature for a URL
packages/: a package to download for each distribution, versioned, and openSUSE Leap 16.0
Debian policy: lintian-clean package, a man page, and the app in /usr/share
AppStream metadata, so GNOME Software and KDE Discover list the app
make release: publish a version to GitHub, OBS and the AUR from this machine

description.p: CPU load, VRAM in use and RAM in GB, and a choice of readings for the panel and the overlay.
The overlay no longer closes by itself. First Debian and Ubuntu package.
